Original authorized Mail query remains complete for all four current records after quota/LRU pressure; source reference, reply blob inode/bytes and all business/source data stay exact
Both original hosts restore fixture callbacks and quit normally; ordinary restarted App has no pending reservations/leases and reuses complete current checkpoint without rescanning
